verdict.rationale: Workable's API is versioned: the documented base path is /spi/v3/. However, the docs explicitly lack an API changelog (/changelog returns 404) and document no deprecation policy, so only the versioning half of the story is evidenced, and only through the base URL. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an API changelog or version history, and any explicit versioning docs beyond the v3 path segment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
